Client: Ebisu Technologies | Bengaluru, India
(05/2019 – 03/2021)

Client: OptivalueTek | Bengaluru, India (01/2022
– Current)
Role: Machine Learning Engineer

Developed backend services and REST APIs using
Django & Flask, deployed in production.
Managed relational and NoSQL databases (MySQL,
PostgreSQL, MongoDB) with optimized queries and
indexes.
Automated data pipelines using Apache Airflow for
scheduling and orchestration.
Integrated third-party APIs for data ingestion and
external service synchronization.
Implemented Celery-based task queues for
background processing and async workflows.
Handled real-time data streams using Kafka and
Spark Streaming.

Built modular Python APIs to serve Power BI
dashboards and expose enterprise data.
Designed and maintained Snowflake schemas,
including partitioning, clustering, and materialized
views.
Developed ETL pipelines in Python (Pandas, NumPy)
and automated workflows for data ingestion.
Wrote complex SQL queries for joins, window
functions, and aggregations, reducing runtime by
40%.
Implemented caching strategies (Redis) to improve
API response times for data queries.
Created data quality validation scripts in Python,
improving consistency across datasets.

Designed and implemented scalable LLM-powered
APIs with FastAPI, leveraging OpenAI, LangChain, and
LlamaIndex for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented
Generation) workflows.
Built AI microservices with Docker for model
inference, embeddings, and retrieval orchestration.
Integrated FAISS and Pinecone vector databases for
semantic search and context-aware retrieval.
Implemented JWT authentication and role-based
access control (RBAC) for secure model API endpoints.
Integrated OpenAI endpoints with MCP (Model
Context Protocol) to enable dynamic function calling
and multi-agent orchestration across real-world
services.
